dimensions.rationale: The union was drawn from all explicit laser procedure references across states, whether authorized or prohibited; synonyms and trivial phrasings were merged (e.g., all references to laser trabeculoplasty into one entry), while genuinely distinct procedures (capsulotomy, trabeculoplasty, peripheral iridotomy, LASIK, PRK, retina laser, diagnostic laser, IPL, LLLT, general/unspecified therapeutic laser, and general surgical laser) were kept separate; items appearing only in exclusion/prohibition lists (e.g., LASIK, PRK, retina laser) are included per instructions.

dimensions.rationale: The union was drawn from all sentences across all states; items appearing only in exclusion or prohibition lists are included as in-scope vocabulary items a state happens to forbid; synonymous phrasings (e.g., 'punctal plug insertion' and 'closure of lacrimal punctum by plug') were merged into one canonical entry, while genuinely distinct procedures (e.g., subconjunctival injection vs. periocular injection vs. botulinum toxin injection) were kept separate; foreign body removal was excluded per the task scope.
